subject.title: feat(control-ui): agent identity editor, Settings-homed Agents page, scalable chip switcher

question: Should Agents become Settings-only by default while remaining eligible for existing and future sidebar pins, or should the PR intentionally remove primary-sidebar placement entirely?
rationale: The route alias preserves URLs but does not decide whether saved navigation placement is a compatibility contract; that permanent product/navigation choice cannot be inferred safely from the implementation alone.

options.title: Settings default, pins preserved
options.body: Move the default discovery location to Settings but keep Agents in the pinnable-route contract so existing user preferences survive.

options.title: Settings-only migration
options.body: Remove Agents from primary navigation intentionally, with explicit approval and tested migration behavior for previously saved pins.

options.title: Keep current navigation
options.body: Land only identity editing and switcher scalability while leaving Agents in the existing sidebar location.

recommendation.title: Settings default, pins preserved
recommendation.body: Move the default discovery location to Settings but keep Agents in the pinnable-route contract so existing user preferences survive.

likelyOwner.reason: The current assignee has the strongest available Control UI product and navigation context for this choice.
